hero_headline: Turn Stream Peaks Into Published Shorts.
hero_sub: Peaks is AuraFlux for the moments that already chart: YouTube Most Replayed, Twitch chat spikes, and Kick CCV peaks. Stage a trim, run the pipeline, publish the Short.

steps.headline: Find the peak
steps.body: Pull YouTube Most Replayed, Twitch chat peaks, or Kick live CCV from My Channels. Pick the window worth shipping.

steps.headline: Stage your trim
steps.body: Upload the clip you cut locally (or from the VOD deeplink). AuraFlux stages it for the Short pipeline without re-downloading the whole VOD on our servers.

steps.headline: Run the pipeline
steps.body: Spec-driven portals assemble, caption, brand, and QA the Short. Only the portals your job needs actually run.

steps.headline: Publish
steps.body: Connect YouTube and TikTok (and more via your social accounts). Metadata and format go out with the job.

final_cta_headline: Ready to Automate Your Stream Clips?
final_cta_sub: Choose a plan to start turning VODs into viral Shorts, or contact us for custom enterprise setups.
